title: Twelve days notice with a compliant re-routing offer
narrative: They cancelled my flight twelve days out and put me on an earlier departure that got in a bit later. I took it. Do I still get paid?

documents.content:
BOOKING VN33QW — Passenger: P. NAKAMURA (adult)
Carrier: Vantage (VN)
VN515  BCN 20 Jun 2026 09:00  ->  CPH 20 Jun 2026 12:30
Great-circle distance BCN-CPH: 1,760 km.
Status: CONFIRMED.

From: changes@vantage.example
Sent: 08 Jun 2026 11:40 UTC
Subject: Change to your booking VN33QW

VN515 on 20 June is cancelled. We have re-routed you onto VN517, departing BCN 20 Jun 08:00 and arriving CPH 20 Jun 16:00 via a stop at FRA. This is confirmed unless you tell us otherwise.
BOARDING PASS VN517 20JUN2026 — NAKAMURA/P — seat 7D — travelled as re-routed

VANTAGE OPS LOG — VN515 / 20JUN2026
Status: CANCELLED (scheduled consolidation, decision date 08JUN)
Cause code: COM-CONS
Cause text: Commercial consolidation of VN515 and VN517.

derivation: S4.1 notice 08 Jun 11:40 -> 20 Jun 09:00 is 11 days 21h, inside the 7-20 day band
S4.3 re-route departed 08:00, 1h before the original 09:00, within the 2h limit
S4.3 re-route arrived 16:00 against an original 12:30, 3h30m late, under the 4h limit
S4.3 exemption applies in full -> no compensation despite a carrier-controlled cause
